subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should Gateway v4 response frames allow optional top-level `res.meta` now, or should metadata wait for a versioned or alternate contract?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proof-backed, but the public protocol envelope changes in a way strict older validators may reject, so automation cannot decide the compatibility posture for maintainers.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
options.body: Merge this shape after ordinary checks, treating optional response metadata as an allowed additive v4 envelope field with docs and generated client updates.

options.title: Require a versioned contract
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a version-gated or payload-level metadata contract if strict v4 clients must never see new top-level fields.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
recommendation.body: Merge this shape after ordinary checks, treating optional response metadata as an allowed additive v4 envelope field with docs and generated client updates.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest available routing candidate for the shared Gateway type and protocol/generated model surfaces touched by the compatibility decision.
